_readme: Every tunable kit parameter, one entry each: '<how> [field=value ...]'. how: quantile, peak, ewma, aimd = learned from live observations (lib.ps1 params, README Configuration params); config = fixed. Fields: default, unit, floor, ceil (learned range; else default/4..x4), q, k, up, down, min, safe, gate, class, sample. Read with Get-KitParam <key> (no literal default at the site: lint PARAM-UNREG, PARAM-DEFAULT); a kit.local.json value at the key's path pins it; bossy.ps1 param show. _literals: tunable literals still in code per file (kitbag.py lint WARN PARAM-LITERAL above it; lint --ratchet lowers it).

params.net.timeoutSec: quantile q=.99 k=3 class=timeout sample=10 default=60 unit=s
params.logs.keepDays: peak k=2 default=90 floor=30 ceil=365 unit=d
params.supervise.shellStuckMinutes: quantile q=.95 k=2 default=30 floor=10 ceil=240 unit=min
